$comment: FIX-1242 — the SHAPE of .claude/board.local.json, with no real times.
Copy it to .claude/board.local.json in the PRIMARY checkout and fill it in.
That path is untracked by construction (.gitignore excludes .claude/*), and
it is meant to be: the supervised windows are when a person is at the
keyboard, which is nobody else's business and is not repo state.
tz is an IANA zone. Each weekday maps to a list of [start, end] local times
(24 h, HH:MM; an end at or before its start runs past midnight) or to a
string such as "variable". An absent weekday draws no footer. pnpm board
converts each window to UTC for that calendar date, so DST is handled per
day, and renders the footer row only when the file exists.
